sentences.en: Eating too much fat is supposed to cause heart disease.
sentences.zh: 摄入太多脂肪据说会导致心脏病。

sentences.en: I try to avoid eating too much for my health.
sentences.zh: 我尽量少吃东西以保持健康。

sentences.en: While eating a pizza he was annoying his sister.
sentences.zh: 他吃比萨的时候在烦扰他的姐姐。

senses.zh: 吃；去餐馆吃饭；在家吃饭
